description: This file is a Perl test script that tests the 'fatal' function from the Git::SVN::Utils module. It overrides the global exit function to capture exit codes, traps STDERR to verify error messages, and verifies that 'fatal' outputs the correct message and exits with code 1.

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Function from Git::SVN::Utils module that prints an error message and terminates execution with exit code 1.
